## Morning: Brindisi on Foot (9 AM–1 PM)

After the intensity of Florence and Naples, Brindisi is refreshingly calm. A working Mediterranean port, not a tourist hotspot — which is exactly the point.

### The Waterfront & Historic Center

**Start:** Coffee at a local bar near the hotel (not a tourist café — ask the hotel where the locals go).

**Walk the inner harbor (Seno di Ponente):**

| Site | What It Is |
|------|-----------|
| **Colonne Romane** | One intact Roman column marking the end of the Appian Way (Via Appia). This is where ancient Rome physically ended — Julius Caesar, Cicero, Virgil all passed through. |
| **Seno di Ponente** | The sheltered inner harbor — fishing boats, Mediterranean ferries, unhurried pace |
| **Castello Svevo** | Norman-era castle on the harbor; exterior worth seeing |
| **Piazza Vittorio Emanuele** | Main square near the waterfront |
| **Corso Garibaldi** | Pedestrian main street into centro storico |

**Walk time:** 60–90 minutes, relaxed pace.

### Museo Archeologico Nazionale di Brindisi (Optional)

- Modest museum with finds from the ancient Greek and Roman city
- Free or low cost entry; helpful context for the columns and the port's 2,500-year history
- Located near the waterfront

---

## Afternoon: Drive to Masseria dei Monaci

After the 12:30 PM pickup at Brindisi Airport, tour drivers transport the group ~2 hours south to **Masseria dei Monaci** — a restored 4-star farm estate near Otranto. Converted from a historic masseria while preserving its past: spacious rooms, inviting courtyards, sea breezes, and ancient olive trees.

Check in, unpack, and settle in. Pool and grounds available.

---

## Evening: Welcome Overview & Dinner

Pamela and Paola present an overview of the week's itinerary. Then: a special **welcome dinner** prepared by the masseria's Pugliese chef (included with local wine).

**Tonight — get organized:**

- [ ] Note pickup times and meeting points from the welcome overview
- [ ] Charge all devices overnight
- [ ] Lay out comfortable walking shoes and sun protection for tomorrow's Otranto day
- [ ] Early night — the first full tour day begins tomorrow
